report:
I made one structural change. It removes the most common reason `main.js` had to be edited, and that same duplication caused a real bug that shipped. The untangle gate passes, and both test suites run the same tests with the same results as before. Nothing is committed yet.

## A bug I found and did not fix
`transcribe/cues/split.py:178`: when audio has no words and `return_words=True`, `split_cues` returns `[]` instead of `([], [])`. On silent audio, `faster_whisper.transcribe` then crashes with a `ValueError` at the line `cues, sub_words = split_cues(...)`. The DP split path has the same problem at lines 416 and 420. The red test `test_transcribe_threads_speech_spans` catches it. Fixing it would change behavior, so I only left an `untangle: known bug:` comment at that line.

## What I changed and why
**The align panel's handler list now lives in one place.** The history showed that every new Transform/Align control had to be added in three files:
- the handler in `features/align.js`
- the DOM wiring in `core/alignPanel.js`
- a re-listed binding in `main.js`

Missing the third step is exactly how the Text 1/2/All switcher broke in a662187: the panel skipped the unbound call without any error.

- `uxp/cutdeck/features/align.js` now builds `intents`, the object the panel's `bind()` receives, right next to the handlers.
- `uxp/cutdeck/main.js` now just calls `alignPanel.bind(align.intents)` instead of listing 12 handlers.
- I dropped `onReset: align.onReset`. It always bound `undefined`, and the panel never calls `onReset`, so behavior is the same.
- I rewrote the test "main.js binds every intent the align panel calls" in `tests/cutdeck_align_panel.test.cjs`. It used to search `main.js`'s source text. Now it builds the real feature and checks that every `intents.onX` the panel calls is a function. The gate confirmed this test fails on the old code, so it will catch the duplication if it comes back.

Adding a new align control now means editing `align.js` and `alignPanel.js` only.

## What I left alone, and why
- **`faster_whisper.py`**: has many fixes, but they cover unrelated areas (CUDA DLLs, voice-activity windows, tail recovery, cues). Code the engines share was already moved into `transcribe/audio` and `transcribe/cues`. What's left only runs on the real decoder, so a GPU is the only way to prove a restructure didn't change it.
- **`adjustmentLayer.js` and `nativeCut.js`**: their fixes are Premiere behaviors learned one live run at a time. A restructure could only be checked against test fakes.
- **`db/store.py`**: by design it's the only file allowed to hold raw SQL, so fixes landing there is expected.
- **`eval/harness.py`**: the pass/fail logic was already moved out to `eval/gate.py`. The remaining fixes are unrelated one-offs.
- **`main.js` + `core/panel.js`**: `main.js` wires handlers from five features into one panel. One explicit line per button keeps name clashes visible, so I didn't merge them implicitly.
- **`align.js` with `alignPanel.js` / `transform/edit.js`**: these are the intended layers (feature, DOM, Premiere writes).

Each module I skipped that has a high share of fix commits has a test command noted in `.untangle/notes.md`, and the gate ran them all.

## How I know nothing broke
I recorded both suites on the committed code before touching anything, then reran them afterwards:
- **Python** (`pytest tests`): 1151 tests before and after, with the same 10 failing.
- **Node** (`node --test tests/*.cjs`): 731 tests before and after, all passing.

The 10 Python failures were already there before my change:
- **8 in `test_text_box.py`**: the `uharfbuzz` package is listed in `requirements.txt` but isn't installed here.
- **1 out-of-date test**: `test_cue_knobs_reach_the_splitter` uses a fake `split_cues` that doesn't accept the `return_words` argument the real code has passed since 307671f.
- **1 real bug**: the `split_cues` one described at the top.

The Premiere panel itself still hasn't been checked live; the tests only exercise it through fakes.

The changes are uncommitted on `master`, plus a `.untangle/` folder with the full reasoning for each file. Commit that folder with the change or delete it.
